missTarget: click the subject in the frame
emptyTitle: Drop a video, or pick one from the library
emptyHint: MP4, MOV, MKV or WEBM, up to 2 GB by default. Videos stay on this computer.
pickHint: Picking a new video clears the subject, blur boxes and speaker marks.
personTitle: Click the person in the frame
personHint: Camera changed after a cut? Move the playhead to the new shot and click again.
personDetecting: Detecting people. Numbered boxes appear when done.
blurHint: Drag a box on the frame; drag a corner to resize, ✕ to delete.
talkTitle: Click a caption to mark lines someone else said
talkHint: Green is the subject, dark grey is someone else. Drag across empty space to mark a span.
talkWait: Captions and shots are still loading; see the timeline below.
summaryHint: One landscape and one portrait video.
jobHint: The job runs on this computer and keeps going if you close the page.
cacheHint: Changing only the title, blur or caption style re-renders for free.
dropHint: or click to choose a file
inspecting: Reading the video and caption area…
subject: Subject
nobody: No one detected in this frame; try another.
peopleBusy: Preparing in the background; person boxes will refresh afterwards.
cannotPlay: This browser can’t play the video; drag the scrubber to step through frames.
speaker: Subject name
noAnchors: Not chosen: click a person in the frame
title: Video title
autoStart: Start where the subject first speaks
estimateBasis: Based on a measured 52 s sample; the first run also reads captions.
estimateCached: Judgements and narration are cached; only the picture is re-rendered.
description: Describe the subject in one sentence (experimental, needs API key)
descriptionHint: Replaces clicking and costs a little API usage; load the timeline manually.
disclaimer: Not human-calibrated · demo only · not a psychological assessment
cuesNeedTarget: Caption blocks appear here once the subject is chosen.
cuesAfterPrepare: Captions and shots load automatically after you leave the Subject step.
failed: Creation failed; open the logs to see why.
prepareFailed: Preparation failed; check the setup in Settings.
historyIntro: Reopen a set of parameters, or watch earlier videos.
keyHint: Only shows whether it is set. A new key is written to the local .env and never shown.
repairModel: Run jevtells download to fetch models and fonts.
repairKey: Enter an OpenRouter key below and save.
repairFfmpeg: Install ffmpeg with libx264 (macOS: brew install ffmpeg).
invalid_request: Invalid input; check the video, subject and range.
busy: A job is already running; wait for it or cancel it.
detect_first: People have not been detected yet.
http_413: The video is over the upload limit.
http_415: This file type is not supported.
select_target: Click the subject in the frame, or enter a description.
range_error: The end must be after the start.
